name: Downsky Causeway V2 · Difficulty 4 · Simplified Interaction
natural_language: Inspect the drifting terraces, then START CROSSING. The walker marches forward continuously. Steer lateral speed with the gold tiller; momentum takes time to reverse. Your whole footprint must fit on a deck. Walking off starts a gravity-driven fall onto a lower deck. Dashed blue outlines show deck positions 0.9 seconds ahead; white streaks show recent drift. Reach the lit pavilion on terrace 7 and CERTIFY ARRIVAL. A fall below the causeway or early certification ends the episode. Click the tiller rail to steer.
